incidents.title: Repeated authentication failures followed by access
incidents.summary: Repeated failures and a later successful authentication warrant a closer look. These records alone do not establish account compromise.
reasons: Repeated failures followed by success in a short period.
The sequence is linked by the same demo account.
benign_explanations: The user may have forgotten a password.
A client may have retained an outdated password.
missing_context: Whether the account owner recognizes this session.
Whether the device and source are expected.
next_steps: Confirm the session with the account owner.
Inspect related activity before deciding on a response.

incidents.title: Unusual DNS queries from one reporting host
incidents.summary: Unusually complex domain names appear repeatedly. Review the original queries and their source before drawing conclusions about data transfer.
reasons: A related frequency signal from the same reporting host.
benign_explanations: An authorized application may encode identifiers in DNS queries.
next_steps: Identify the originating process or device.
Compare destination domains with expected services.
